name: Invitation Status
summary: Describes the lifecycle of a workspace invitation independently from identity proof and membership.

values.name: None
values.summary: No invitation is attached to the current journey.

values.name: Attached
values.summary: Invitation context is attached but not yet validated.

values.name: Valid
values.summary: The invitation is valid and may be reviewed.

values.name: Acceptance Pending
values.summary: A durable identity has been selected and acceptance awaits confirmation or execution.

values.name: Accepted
values.summary: Membership was added and the invitation consumed.

values.name: Expired
values.summary: The invitation can no longer be accepted.

values.name: Invalid
values.summary: The invitation proof or target is invalid.
